title: Derived mate compatibility with the right-derived unit
statement: For shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], let f:X→S, f′:X′→S′, g:S′→S and p:X′→X be scheme morphisms with p f=f′ g. Assume tensor pullback along g and p additive. Write Fh, Gh and Ph for the termwise homotopy functors of f pushforward, g tensor pullback and p tensor pullback. Let δ be the pinned left-derived counits [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition], and η_f the recorded right-derived units [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Define b_D: Gh(Fh D)→f′_* (Ph D) by termwise moduleBaseChangeMap [lem-weil-pbc-module-base-change-map-open-restriction], including the composition identifications on homotopy categories. For every homotopy complex D of X-modules, Lg*(η_f(D)) followed by the pinned derived mate [def-pc-derived-base-change-map] at QhD followed by Rf′*(δ_p(D)) equals δ_g(FhD) followed by Qh(b_D) followed by η_f′(PhD). No acyclicity or geometric hypotheses are imposed.

proof.text: Transpose under the pinned derived adjunction for f′. Use its compatibility with the ordinary tensor adjunction, left-derived counits and right-derived units to expand both sides. The universal-property characterization of the derived composition comparison replaces successive counits by the composite counit, and the square identifies those composites. Naturality and both triangle identities leave the ordinary base-change map. Descend the termwise exchange to homotopy categories and localize, then transpose back.

theorem derivedBaseChange_unit_compatibility
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (p : X' ⟶ X)
    (h : p ≫ f = f' ≫ g)
    [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).Additive]
    [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p).Additive]
    (D : HomotopyCategory X.Modules (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) :
    (derivedPullback g).map
        ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app D) ≫
      schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g p h (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj D) ≫
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map
        (((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
          exists_derivedPullbackComposition.{u, w})) p).app D) =
    ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
        exists_derivedPullbackComposition.{u, w})) g).app
        (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj D) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((moduleHomotopyBaseChange f f' g p h).app D) ≫
      (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f'.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app
        (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj D)
